design_vibe: Warm & festive combined with Dark & premium. Ember-lit food festival aesthetic with charcoal/ink backgrounds and warm saffron, amber, and flame-orange accents.

typography.pairing_strategy: Editorial Serif for Display + Clean Grotesk for UI/Body. Do not use generic fonts for headings.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter font-light

visual_enhancers.grain: Subtle noise overlay on the background to remove digital flatness. Use an SVG filter or background-image with noise.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows using accent colors instead of hard drop shadows. e.g. shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(255,90,0,0.15)]
visual_enhancers.borders: Ultra-delicate. Use 1px solid white/10 for separators.

layouts.core_structure: Asymmetrical Split View (Desktop). Left side: 35% width sticky booking panel. Right side: 65% width scrolling content. Mobile: Stacked, booking panel at bottom or top.
layouts.booking_panel: Sticky rail on left (h-screen sticky top-0). Elevate using crystal glassmorphism over the dark theme. Must contain the booking form, time slots, and total price.
layouts.main_content: Right side. Contains Kinetic Hero, Manifesto Chapters, Marquee, Image Galleries.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections. gap-12 or gap-20 for bento grids.

booking_form.inputs: Floating labels or clean underline inputs (border-b border-white/20, bg-transparent, rounded-none, px-0 py-3). Focus state: border-white text-white.
booking_form.time_slots: Minimalist pills. border border-white/20 rounded-full px-6 py-2 hover:border-[#FF5A00] transition-colors aria-selected:bg-[#FF5A00] aria-selected:border-[#FF5A00] aria-selected:text-white cursor-pointer.
booking_form.price_display: Large editorial serif numbers (e.g. text-5xl font-serif text-[#FFB01D]). Dynamic update.
booking_form.payment_button: Multi-state button. Idle: Solid #FF5A00. Loading: Spinner replacing text. Success: Green/Checkmark with 'Booking Confirmed'. Full width, py-4, text-sm tracking-widest uppercase.

manifesto_chapters.structure: Numbered sections (01, 02, 03). Huge semi-transparent serif numbers positioned absolutely behind the content.
manifesto_chapters.text: Staggered reveal on scroll. High contrast text.

marquee.style: Slow editorial ribbon. font-serif text-3xl or 4xl. Low contrast (text-[#FFB01D]/30). Huge gaps (gap-32) between items. Text e.g., 'FIRE & SMOKE • EXCLUSIVE TASTING • CULTURAL RENAISSANCE •'

motion.scrolling: MUST use Lenis (@studio-freight/react-lenis) for premium momentum scrolling.
motion.kinetic_hero: Framer Motion line-by-line reveal. Wrap each line of h1 in an overflow-hidden div, animate the inner span from y: '100%', opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1. Stagger children by 0.1s. Easing: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform to move hero images at a different speed than the document scroll.
motion.scroll_reveals: Fade up and slight Y-translate (e.g. y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) on all manifesto sections as they enter viewport. duration 0.8s, ease out.

image_urls.description: Chef cooking with fire, dark moody. Use in right-side kinetic hero behind text.
Masterful flame handling. Use in chapter 01 (The Craft).
Night food festival scene. Use in chapter 02 (The Atmosphere).
Ember sparks in the dark. Can be used as a blending background or absolute positioned accent image.

accessibility.focus_states: All form inputs must have high-contrast focus rings or border color changes.
accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure all decorative numbers have aria-hidden='true'. Time slot pills must use aria-selected to denote state.
accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure white text and saffron accents against #0A0A0A meet APCA guidelines (they will).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution_order: 1. Setup layout skeleton (Left Fixed 35%, Right Scroll 65%). 2. Implement Lenis for smooth scroll. 3. Build Booking Panel with state (mock payment flow). 4. Build right side content (Hero, Chapters, Marquee). 5. Add Framer Motion reveals.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the distinct Split Screen asymmetrical layout exactly as requested.
Create depth using grain overlays and the dark glassmorphism panel on the left.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use the specified editorial serif fonts.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, time slots, payment button).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on elements where content scrolls beneath (the left panel must have blur + 75% opacity dark background).
Do not apply global CSS transitions (e.g., transition: all). Only target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
Do not center align the whole app. The right content should be beautifully left-aligned to establish typographic tension.
The payment button must cycle through states: Idle -> Loading (spinner) -> Success (Checkmark) upon clicking.
